title: Invoice gating for security questionnaire hold and metering dispute automation
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Background: Large enterprise customers frequently request that invoices be placed on hold while completing security questionnaires, audits, or remediation tasks. Today this is handled ad hoc by Support/Finance: manual holds, spreadsheet tracking, and reactive credits after the fact. This process causes operational overhead, missed SLA windows, inconsistent crediting (over/under refunds), and poor audit trails.

Goal: Build an integrated invoice-gating and metering-dispute automation flow that ties the security questionnaire workflow (Sales/SE/Support artifact) to billing operations so holds are applied consistently, metering snapshots are captured, provisional credits or deferred invoices can be issued automatically, and everything is auditable for SOC/ISO reviews. The flow should minimize manual touchpoints while preserving legal and accounting controls required for enterprise contracts.

Scope: API + Console UI changes for placing/removing holds, server-side metering snapshotting and provisional-credit issuance, webhooks for downstream ERP/accounting systems, audit log enhancements, policy TTLs and contract-level exceptions, and a lightweight review step for finance. This ticket covers product requirements, acceptance criteria, rollout plan, and release gating. Engineering epic ENG-8844 will own implementation; legal/accounting approvals are a required dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Console: Billing > Invoices shows a new 'Security Hold' workflow that allows Support/Finance to place an org-level or contract-level hold and attach a questionnaire ID or ticket link.
API: New /v1/billing/holds endpoints to create/list/cancel holds with fields: org_id, contract_id, reason, created_by, ttl_seconds, snapshot_id (optional).
Metering: When a hold is created, system captures a metering snapshot (token counts, in-flight ops, reserved capacity usage) and pins current rates for provisional-credit calculations.
Credits: System can auto-calculate a provisional credit estimate and optionally apply it as a soft-credit ledger entry pending finance approval.
Audit: All hold actions emit immutable audit logs (user, timestamp, attachments) surfaced in Console and exported to the customer's audit log stream and internal finance streams.
Webhooks: A webhook is emitted on hold creation/cancellation and on provisional-credit application to integrate with ERP (Finance) systems.
Safety: Holds cannot be used to circumvent payment collection indefinitely; TTL defaults to 30 days and requires Finance escalation for extensions.
Edge cases: Resolved disputes reconcile against the snapshot to avoid double-crediting when token usage post-hold is billed.
Security: Endpoint access gated by RBAC (Billing Admin, Finance, Support) and SSO groups; KMS-backed signing for webhook payloads.
Monitoring: New dashboard shows active holds, time-to-resolution, number of provisional credits issued, and dispute rollback rate.
Documentation: Internal playbook and external customer-facing KB article describing hold lifecycle and expected timelines are published at rollout.
updates: 2026-02-22: Kickoff with Finance and Sales engineering. Agreed on default TTL=30d and required Finance approval for >30d extensions. Action: ENG to estimate snapshot implementation.
2026-02-27: Legal reviewed provisional-credit wording and requested audit trail for each credit; Legal to approve final copy by 2026-03-10. Added as dependency for release gating.

2026-03-03: Engineering (ENG-8844) proposed capturing metering snapshot as an append-only snapshot stored in object store with hash and expiration. Verified feasibility with infra team — low perf impact on write path when creating hold.
2026-03-05: Design reviewed Console mockups (link below). Request: show 'hold reason' and 'origination ticket' prominently; add 'apply provisional credit' checkbox for Finance users.
2026-03-09: Security review kickoff — threat model suggests webhook signing and RBAC enforcement. Security requested pen test on webhook consumer flow prior to GA.

2026-03-12: Product/Engineering sync: scope approved for initial GA (create/list/cancel holds, snapshot, provisional-credit ledger, webhooks, audit logs). Split follow-ups into two subsequent tickets for 'bulk hold' and 'partial-contract holds'.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (GA): small pilot with three enterprise customers (Sales-run) and internal Finance; monitor metrics for two billing cycles. Phase 2: broaden to all enterprise tenants and add bulk-hold and contract-partition features. Disable auto-apply provisional credits by default for pilot. Require Finance opt-in via console toggle for auto-crediting.
metrics: Reduction in manual disputes per 100 invoices (target: 40% drop in pilot)
Median time-to-resolution for security holds (target: <7 days for pilot)
Provisional credit accuracy: % of provisional credits reversed or adjusted after final reconciliation (target: <8%)
Number of hold-related missed collections avoided (target: >90% successful prevents)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-crediting customers if snapshot logic mismatches final meter — Mitigation: conservative provisional credit formula and finance approval gate before ledger write.
Risk: Legal/accounting objections to automated credits — Mitigation: include explicit audit trail and a two-step finance signoff for credits > configurable threshold.
Risk: Performance impact when creating snapshots for very large orgs — Mitigation: incremental snapshot batching and async background job with clear UX state and timeout handling.
Risk: Customers may abuse hold flow to delay payment — Mitigation: TTL limits, contract-level exceptions require Legal signoff, and SSO-gated permissions.

Legal to sign off on provisional-credit language by 2026-03-18
Design to hand off Console mocks and accessibility notes by 2026-03-19
Schedule pilot customers and create runbook for Finance (support + playbook) by 2026-03-26
